folds.inner_stop_rule: lowest sha256 of canonical JSON {namespace:m06b-inner-v1,seed:13,outer_fold,image_group_id} among the 80 outer-training groups

features.null_rule: numeric null becomes zero only beside its frozen availability flag
features.continuous_scaler: per-column mean and population standard deviation fitted on inner-train groups only; std below 1e-12 becomes one
features.final_scaler: fit once on all fit100 groups after model lock
features.categorical_encoding: fixed-vocabulary one-hot; no target-frequency encoding and no learned class frequency

joint_pooling.deployable_atom_representation_and_q_pal: frozen feature area divided by total feature area in the state-action
joint_pooling.supervised_pal_loss_and_reconstruction_m: target valid_pixel_count divided by total valid pixels in the state-action
joint_pooling.reason: target-only valid-pixel counts may weight supervision and evaluation but never enter a deployment prediction

B0_STOP.prediction: all noncanonical gains are zero and STOP wins ties

B1_RANDOM.rule: uniform random ordering of feasible A1-A6 per state using a stable state-and-seed digest

B2_GLOBAL_ACTION_PRIOR.rule: inner-train state-equal mean signed gain by action; outer-held-out statistics forbidden

B3_COST_AWARE_ACTION_PRIOR.rule: B2 predicted gain minus lambda times measured action cost

optimization.batch_unit_qg: complete states; full eligible split batch per epoch
optimization.batch_unit_pal: complete state-actions with all atoms; full eligible split batch per epoch
optimization.pairwise_rows: informative pairs only, averaged inside state then across states
optimization.q_gain_rows: feasible actions averaged inside state then across states
optimization.pal_rows: valid-pixel weighted inside state-action then state-actions equally weighted
optimization.zero_valid_atom_rows: retained with zero supervision weight and never assigned a fabricated target
optimization.determinism: fixed NumPy and PyTorch seeds; deterministic algorithms; TF32 disabled

metrics.stop_rule: STOP utility is zero; execute the highest-scoring feasible A1-A6 only when its score is strictly positive; stable action order breaks action ties
metrics.oracle_positive_gain: max(0, true signed gains of feasible A1-A6)
metrics.top1_regret: oracle_positive_gain minus true gain of selected action, with STOP true gain zero
metrics.top2_regret: oracle_positive_gain minus best true gain among the two highest predicted choices including STOP
metrics.high_gain_state: top ceil(20% of outer-held-out states ordered by descending oracle_positive_gain then state_id
metrics.spearman: average-rank Pearson correlation; undefined constant cases are null

budget_evaluation.selection: rank states by maximum positive predicted_gain-minus-lambda-cost; select at most ceil(fraction*heldout_state_count), STOP otherwise
budget_evaluation.gpu_budget_rule: level times the sum of minimum feasible positive A1-A6 cost per inner-training state, scaled by heldout_state_count/inner_training_state_count
budget_evaluation.gpu_selection: descending positive utility subject to cumulative measured selected-action cost not exceeding the frozen training-derived budget

crossfit.prediction_unit: one unique out-of-fold prediction per eligible row/group after seed averaging
crossfit.seed_ensemble: arithmetic mean prediction across registered seeds within the same model and outer fold

selection.final_epoch_rule: round half up the median outer-run best_epoch for that model; minimum one

fit_gates.G1: some learned Q candidate lowers normalized top-1 regret by at least 10% versus the aggregate-best non-learned baseline and is better in at least four folds
fit_gates.G2: selected Q captures at least 50% oracle positive gain at 20% action rate and exceeds the strongest non-learned baseline by at least 0.05 absolute
fit_gates.G3: selected Q high-gain recall is at least 0.50 and exceeds B4 by at least 0.10 absolute
fit_gates.G4: selected Q informative pairwise accuracy is at least 0.60 and exceeds B2 by at least 0.05 absolute
fit_gates.G5: some learned PAL candidate lowers reconstructed MAE by at least 10% versus P0 and is better in at least four folds
fit_gates.G6: J1 normalized regret is no more than 2% worse than the best Q-only model, improves normalized regret by at least 5% or 20% capture by 0.05 or high-gain recall by 0.05, and J1 PAL MAE is no more than 2% worse than the best PAL-only model

final_fit_and_validation.prerequisite: fit-only crossfit report and model lock committed before validation row access
final_fit_and_validation.final_epochs: locked by selection.final_epoch_rule; no validation early stopping
final_fit_and_validation.V1: selected learned Q normalized regret is lower than the strongest non-learned baseline
final_fit_and_validation.V2: selected learned Q 20% gain-capture fraction is higher than the strongest non-learned baseline
final_fit_and_validation.V3: validation normalized regret is at most 1.50 times fit crossfit normalized regret
final_fit_and_validation.V4: validation selected PAL reconstructed MAE is at most 1.50 times fit crossfit MAE
final_fit_and_validation.V5: executed non-stop actions do not all collapse to one action unless validation oracle-best support also collapses to that action
final_fit_and_validation.failure: any V1-V5 failure yields STOP-BLOCKED_M06_VALIDATION_GENERALIZATION without retry

stop_conditions: input identity, schema, row count, fold, or held-out audit mismatch
target reconstruction, target definition, informative margin, fold, action, or atom modification
validation row access before fit-only model lock commit
validation use for model, hyperparameter, feature, scaler, epoch, threshold, or blend selection
calibration30, pilot-test30, or official VOC val label or target access
SAM inference, new prompt/action/trajectory/atom, dataset/model download, DDP, model parallel, calibration, routing, student training, checkpoint/source/environment modification, or Git push
total GPU wall, per-run VRAM, or artifact limits exceeded
